4-word salts stand in for the card's '4-token salt'

documents were resized from the card's ~8k to an offline-estimator target of 10400 tokens after an aborted calibration run measured this text at 4.8491 chars/token (8k-est documents came out at 7,126 prompt tokens, so a 300-document pool could only reach 1.31x capacity); the calibration rows are kept in calibration_aborted_run.jsonl and its 69 requests are counted against the cap
the pressure target is enforced on measured prompt_tokens; if the 300-document pool runs out first, the achieved ratio is reported instead of the target
Phase D documents are the slice immediately after the middle band, because the middle band itself was replayed in Phase R and would be double-warmed
band replay order is newest->middle->oldest so the (expected) evicted band's re-insertion cannot perturb the resident bands measured before it
